notes.title: v 1.0.2 "Card Generation build" content update
notes.notes:
Game update v 1.0.2 is Live!

[b]This is mostly an content update, to make a "Card Generation build" more viable[/b] (a new way to build a competitive deck).

[list]
[*] Introduced a new concept of a "Scalable Card" that can now be generated
[*] New Card "Scala Developer" that generates a Scalable Dev Card" after it gets fired
[*] New Card "Recursive Coder", a dev cards that scales after we generate a cards.
[*] New Module "Generator Virus" that make our opponents loose some Project Points after we generate a cards.
[*] Tweaked booster packs logic: now we always get at least 1 PLUS card in a booster, to make the player feel better after an unlucky RNG booster cards roll.
[*] Some minor fixes, typos etc.
[/list]


Have fun,
Matt

notes.title: v 1.0.1 Bugfix and Target FPS Limit update
notes.notes:
First post launch update!

[h1]Bugfix and Target FPS Limit update + 1 new module
[/h1]

[strike]The update is [b]currently only on a "beta" test branch[/b], but should be pushed public in 1-2 days (if no bugs get found).[/strike]
Edit: the update is already live for everyone.

[strike]If you want to get the newest version right away: just switch on the Full Game on Steam under "Betas" to the "beta - test branch".[/strike]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40963475/3e0222f9256862e462a742aa2fed3dc01515bc26.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Added "Target FPS Limit" to the Screen Settings, as some players with a beefy PC provided feedback that the game can run on a milion FPS and this makes the GPU go crazy :P if this is the case for you: now you can set a "Target FPS Limit".
[*] New Modificator Module: "Generator Magic" that gains us resources each 2nd time we generate a card. [b]This is just a first part of new upcoming content to make a "Generate build" more viable[/b] (there will be more added: for example a Dev Card that scales with card generation).
[*] BUGFIX: playing Knowledge Cards on taken over employees had some edge cases with the indicator glowing red (but the card was playable), this is now fixed.
[*] BUGFIX: playing Knowledge Cards on spawned Overemployed Developer copies had some edge cases with the indicator glowing red (but the card was playable), this is now fixed.
[*] BUGFIX: fixed concede battle edge case that cause the "End Turn" button to be active outside of a Project Battle.
[*] BUGFIX: fixed targeting text for cards that Absorb Burnout
[*] BUGFIX: fixed edge case of "Mystery Box" starter module and "Power Generator" combination (generate mechanic was not triggering twice like on the module text), this is now fixed.
[*] BUGFIX: fixed upgraded Card UI masking issue during card upgrade in scroll view
[*] BUGFIX: some typo fixes
[*] What is also investigated: an edge case has been reported that a starter deck did not unlock after winning a run. Currently I was not able to reproduce this scenario (it looks like a rare edge case), but this is under investigation. If this happens to you: please let me know any details of your run that could help with finding it!
[/list]


More will come soon. This is just a first package with fixes and some new stuff. :)

Have fun,
Matt

notes.title: Release date and final beta tests!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone!

We have a release date: if nothing catastrophic happens the first version of the game is going to release [b]20 Nov, 2024[/b].

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40963475/0b4004204f769e21c905b1399cf8846e4a4748f7.jpg[/img]

We are currently doing some final beta tests, UI/UX tweaks, implementing Steam Achievements, Steam Cloud Save and we are ready for release!

Thank you to everyone who helped with beta testing so far! The game has changed a lot in the last few months.

Do you want to be a part of the final beta tests? You can do so be [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScmH7rg8Si9QoXq0ZkMIK7EMNr359XrMGM1Df-W_AVI9lNj6A/viewform]signing up with this form[/url], or just by asking for access [url=https://discord.com/invite/KWnjqEkGVK]on our Discord[/url].


[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/40963475/2dd824adbf41afca32e0d8c71631de962e4f9ec2.png[/img]

After initial release the plan is to provide additional game updates for about ~6 months (maybe more if it gets decent tracktion on Steam).

Have fun,
Matt

notes.title: Major Demo update [Starter Deck Drafting]
notes.notes:
Major demo update!

As requested by the players: [b]starter deck drafting was added to the game[/b].
The "random cards" starter deck was removed (it was not really popular, as you had to reroll it a lot to get something interesting) and in it's place a "draft your custom deck" option was added!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/40963475/b554ff9b379f0ec964e3f90ca1e69fbd0aba78d0.png[/img]

There will be some experimentation with this in the future, but for now the card options in the draft are totally random (with a small twist of having the ability to pick 1 upgraded card in the draft).

Randomization of Tech Quizes and Meeting was also finally added to the demo (in previous demo version was always had the same questions/'random meetings'). 

As always: [url=https://discord.com/invite/KWnjqEkGVK]feel free to join our discord[/url] and add your suggestions base on the current demo version!

Cheers,
Matt
